name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to make its first EU-wide anti-corruption strategy, due by the end of 2026, stronger. It wants more focus on preventing corruption, not just punishing it. It asks for common rules on conflicts of interest, lobbying, gifts and political funding, and for better cooperation between countries and EU bodies. It also wants whistleblowers and journalists protected. The Parliament is giving its opinion; it is not changing any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to include these measures in its strategy.
- **Who it affects:** EU institutions, national governments, public officials, companies and civil society groups.
- **What happens next:** The Commission drafts the strategy, planned for adoption by the end of 2026.
